about_the_game:
Ding Dong Dang is massively multiplayer online casual and competitive game, with easy and enjoyable casual gameplays and a variety of 3D characters. There are three islands for you to explore as you want. Enjoy punching any players aside! Jump to find the perfect viewpoint! Head for interaction areas to unlock new actions! Get golds everywhere! Don't forget to greet your friends in Lobby. There might be surprises for you!

Ding Dong Dang allows 4 players to join the game simultaneously. You can easily play diverse game genres without entry barriers!

The private room function will make it easier for you and your friends to compete together. Bring you double joy! In Ding Dong Dang, you can experience mini-games with different gameplays such as competition, survival, level-breaking, treasure hunting, racing, sports, puzzle, shooting, etc., making your gaming experience full of fun!

Single-player games bring you back to the childhood. Challenge continuously, get higher ranking, enjoy the thrill of stage clear!

Spin to unlock heroes. Merge the pieces of the same hero to level up, build your strongest team and then take on powerful enemies!

Of course, you can earn extra rewards from Ranking, Achievement and Gallery, by beating others in-game and completing Tasks!

Are you ready to beat them? Come and choose your character to join Ding Dong Dang NOW! Invite your friends and families to download Ding Dong Dang. Share love and joy in Real-Time!

note: Crayon Shin-Chan IP related artwork is under supervision.

Please stay tuned for occasional game updates. We always put players' gaming experience first!
